purpose: Exact-byte independent prefreeze review of the five-file Rust semantic-provider protocol v4 successor. This review independently reconstructs the v4 null type rule, closed transition transaction, retained Rust protocol surfaces, supervisor reducer and host finalizer from binding JSON. It neither applies nor seals the candidate.

verdict.statement: The exact v4 five-file set closes all three v3 blockers and retains the seven v1 repairs and twenty implementation decisions. Nullability is derivable solely from the nominal JSON. The precheck pipeline and every transition result are closed, and two independent executables agree on exact result records across all required cases and traces. The finalizer commitments are reproducible from exactly the six declared dimensions. No architecture or commitment-integrity blocker was found.

verifiedConsequences: Malformed phase=FAULT objects absorb unchanged before state/event validation.
Malformed non-FAULT objects roll back to an insertion-order-preserving recursive copy with only phase replaced or appended.
Non-object states return the fieldless REJECT_NON_OBJECT_STATE variant.
Terminal output immediately commits only phase=FAULT and does not run frame precheck or rule selection.
Rejected frames and runtime failures discard staged writes.
Ordinary rules commit accepted frame sequence increments.
T028 is a controlled fault commit and retains the accepted frame sequence increment.
Pre- and post-invariant failures return exact-original rollback with their declared failure stages.
